message.reasoning_content: Price now: counter 0, base 12 + boom 2 = 14 per unit. Next market (round 6) cash devalues to 62%. So sell now for hard cash is better than promissory (promissory adds next round without devaluation... actually promissory is added at start of round 6 and not devalued — sell_credit avoids devaluation!). Cash 14.35M will devalue to floor(14.353/100)*62 ≈ 8.9M. Selling credit gives promissory 46.25M added after devaluation — full value. Sell credit 3 units: promissory 46.25M, plus final market? Round 6 last market: sell remaining goods... but goods=0 after. Alternative: sell now at 14+ prices, later prices drop. Selling all 3 on credit nets 46.25M post-devaluation vs sell cash 37M→ devalued to ~22.9M. So choice 6.
